# Closed null superclass binding

A descriptor-only child passes null to a complete covariant constructor slot
beside a literal label, a context with a closed generic parent, aliased references
and wide primitive values. Null supplies no generic formal or represented class.

Frozen direct, compiled, reflective and method-handle callers observe null and
reference identity, initialization order, missing unrelated classes, repeated
attempts, exact thrown objects and primitive bits. Source and SDK layouts compile
every emitted source and preserve original definitions, generic signatures,
exceptions, access and Code-presence roles.
